parameters.content:
## Historical Billing Sync — Greenfield & Associates

INSPECTION ONLY. The formatter flags missing matter IDs and missing/non-positive hours; it does NOT compare duplicate matter IDs or provide idempotency. Entries considered valid can proceed toward Clio even when other entries are queued for manual review. An audit entry is not guaranteed on failure. Do not connect live billing accounts.

## Actual conflict predicate and limits

The Code predicate flags only missing matter IDs or missing/non-positive hours. It does NOT detect duplicate matters, same-date repeats, zero total amounts, or prior Clio writes. The queue and Slack alert are advisory; the valid-record path can proceed toward Clio independently. No human approval or exactly-once billing is proven. Do not deploy.

## Historical transformation, not a batch guarantee

The formatter maps case-management fields into billing-shaped records and strips null/empty values. This JSON has no SplitInBatches or Wait node: the prior claim of ten-record batches with a one-second interval was not implemented. Rates divide amount by hours; inspect non-positive and missing values before any adaptation. No live billing safety claim is made.
